claims.claim: The local SORELIA pipeline executes end to end and writes longitudinal failure-frontier artifacts.
The fixed-budget comparison gives every curriculum the same number of verified training tasks per iteration.
The SORELIA comparison path uses longitudinal frontier transitions rather than the legacy static scheduler after the first training round.
The repository contains an executable real Chromium/Playwright fixture path with state-based grading.
SORELIA outperforms state-of-the-art frontier computer-use agents.
SORELIA improves frontier-model reliability under paper-scale real-agent evaluation.
The evaluation harness supports repeated task trials and paired bootstrap/randomization inference for multiseed SORELIA-vs-baseline comparisons.
Cross-round primary mechanism identity is assigned globally rather than greedily.
The v0.7 repeated-trial synthetic release smoke does not support a SORELIA superiority claim and is retained as a null/adverse engineering result.
The fixed-budget benchmark includes an executable static failure-priority baseline distinct from longitudinal SORELIA.
The harness executes and reports a deterministic shifted stress split separately from IID held-out evaluation.
Cross-round mechanism matches report similarity and ambiguity margins.
The repository has an executable core ablation harness for full, static-priority, no-exploration, and single-iteration variants.
The end-to-end and comparison harnesses block exact train/eval task-ID or semantic-fingerprint leakage and report near-duplicate diagnostics.
The ablation harness executes shuffled-failure-label and random-cluster-assignment negative controls.
The repository exports blank human matching-annotation packets and can score inter-annotator agreement and matcher-vs-human calibration without fabricating human judgments.
Automatic failure-mechanism matching is validated against human annotations on real-agent trajectories.
The rollout engine exposes an observation-aware provider-agnostic model boundary and records agent-supplied model identity.
Flagship end-to-end runs write a deterministic benchmark split manifest with per-task fingerprints and split SHA-256 digests before training.
The repository exposes a runtime doctor that separates core dependency readiness from optional browser integration readiness.
The repository contains optional OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages adapters whose request/response and usage parsing paths are executable without credentials through injected fake clients.
Rollouts no longer invent token counts or monetary cost for agents that do not report measured usage, and aggregate metrics distinguish unknown usage/cost from measured zero.
OpenAI or Anthropic proprietary frontier models were executed in the released SORELIA experiments.
The flagship project page contains the required 14-section reviewer path and release-tested local artifact links.
The released MP4 is an evidence-grounded trajectory replay visualization tied to a retained Chromium fixture, not a claimed screen recording or frontier-model run.
The release includes standalone architecture, failure-frontier and portfolio-card visual assets used by the public project page and paper.
